description: Source code for the NXP temperature monitor driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing sensor fetch and channel get functionalities, including calibration data handling and device initialization.

methods.name: nxp_tempmon_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches temperature measurement data from the hardware sensor.

methods.name: nxp_tempmon_channel_get
methods.description: Converts raw sensor data into a temperature value.

methods.name: nxp_tempmon_init
methods.description: Initializes the temperature sensor device, reads calibration data.
